notes.title: Grass fixes and more
notes.notes:
- Fix grass floating above terrain
- Add more sparkles to increase item visibility even in tall grass
- Work around a driver bug on Intel GPUs
- Adjust vertical FoV based on screen aspect ratio
- Increase text size in the inventory
- Cuttable trees
- Fix bug with camera dialogue transitions
- Add different impact sounds to different enemies

notes.title: Fix the Steam Deck
notes.notes: - Fix the game hanging the GPU when run on the steam deck

notes.title: Grasslands Update
notes.notes:
- Added grass
- Adjusted Stamina regeneration
- Added stamina upgrades to chests
- Fixed a bug where the cannons exploded after loading a save
- Fixed a bug that broke the leviathan fight if you saved during it
- Temporarily removed mimalloc to fix and issue on RDNA4 GPUs
